title: Oxva Origin X 510 Thread Adapter
description: The Origin X pod kit from Oxva is a sleek and versatile pod kit that uses Oxva’s UNI coils for incredible flavour and reliable performance. The Origin X pods utilise Oxva’s excellent UNI coils for amazing flavour and an external 18650 battery provides reliable power and longevity. Comfortable to use and highly-portable, the Origin X by Oxva is a discreet yet powerful pod kit ideal for vapers of all levels. The Origin 510 Thread Adapter Connector has been designed specifically for Origin X Pod Vape Kit and allows you to transform your Origin X Pod Vape Kit into a normal 510 thread box mod kit to use different tanks.
